title: Perturbation is All You Need for Extrapolating Language Models
summary: This paper develops a statistical theory of extrapolation for large language models, by reinterpreting them through pre-post-additive noise models. In contrast to the standard autoregressive next-token prediction based on an exact prefix, we introduce a perturbation-based procedure that first transforms the prefix into a semantic neighbour and then conditions on this perturbed variant for next-token prediction.
